Vulcan Value Partners Llc increased its stake in Oracle Corp (ORCL) by 3.83% based on its latest 2018Q2 regulatory filing with the SEC. Vulcan Value Partners Llc bought 922,785 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.22% with the market. The institutional investor held 25.02M shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2018Q2, valued at $1.10B, up from 24.10M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Vulcan Value Partners Llc who had been investing in Oracle Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $184.20B market cap company. The stock increased 0.60% or $0.29 during the last trading session, reaching $48.62. About 13.86M shares traded. Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) has declined 6.50% since November 22, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 22.12% the S&P500.
Vulcan Value Partners Llc, which manages about $6.07 billion and $12.93 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Mastercard Incorporated (NYSE:MA) by 324,037 shares to 2.85M shares, valued at $560.75 million in 2018Q2, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Moodys Corp (NYSE:MCO) by 768,468 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 309,137 shares, and cut its stake in Anthem Inc (NYSE:ANTM).
